title: Cancel a subscription
content_data:
Use this endpoint to cancel a subscription. ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path|/v1.2/subscription/unsubscribe/|/v1.3/subscription/unsubscribe/| |Request parameter data type|`app_id`: number
`subscription_id`:number|`app_id`: string
`subscription_id`:string| |Response parameter data type|`subscription_id`:number|`subscription_id`:string| ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/subscription/unsubscribe/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field|Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Content-Type {Required}|string| The content type of the request. For this endpoint, use `application/json`.| ``` **Parameters** ```xtable | Field | Type | Description | |---|---|---| |app_id{Required}|string| ID of your developer application. You can find the App ID by navigating to [My Apps](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/apps/) > App Detail > Basic Information.| |secret {Required}|string| Secret of your developer application. You can find the Secret by navigating to [My Apps](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/apps/) > App Detail > Basic Information. | |subscription_id {Required}|string| The subscription ID.
You can get the IDs of subscriptions under an app via `subscription_id` returned by [/subscription/get/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739093832125442). | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl -H "Access-Token:xxx" -H "Content-Type:application/json" -X POST \ -d '{ "secret": "SECRET", "app_id": "APP_ID", "subscription_id": "SUBSCRIPTION_ID" }' \ https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/subscription/unsubscribe/ (/code) ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field|Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code |number|The response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message |string|The response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |data |object|The returned data. | #|subscription_id|string| The subscription ID. | |request_id |string|The unique ID of the request. ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "message": "OK", "code": 0, "data": { "subscription_id": 6934682745658408966 }, "request_id": "2021030113504601023101600705098212" } (/code); ```
